name: EX-10 Full Spectrum Warfare — 5 Days
description: 5-day full-spectrum warfare exercise. D1–D2 working hours (planning and pre-deployment); D3–D4 around-the-clock (combat operations); D5 working hours (transition to stability and AAR). Demonstrates how exercise intensity and tempo change across phases. Includes information operations, cyber, conventional, and stability elements. The most comprehensive template for advanced exercise planning.

locks.reason: D1 overnight recess — exercise resumes Day 2
D2 pre-deployment hold — operational security, no new planning inputs
D3 sustainment window — resupply, no offensive operations
D4 transition window — stand-down from combat

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: Exercise begins. D1 is the planning phase — no combat activities. Focus on mission analysis and COA development.

items.title: Commander's Intelligence Brief
items.description: Intelligence officer briefs the full intelligence picture: enemy dispositions, capabilities, terrain, weather, and own-force status.

items.title: Mission Analysis
items.description: Commanders and staff conduct structured mission analysis. Restated mission, METT-TC, initial commander's guidance.

items.title: Course of Action Development
items.description: Staff develops three courses of action (COA). Each COA must address the full spectrum: info ops, cyber, conventional, and stability end state.

items.title: COA Briefback
items.description: Staff briefs three COAs to the commander. Commander selects COA 2 with modifications. Commander's estimate complete.

items.title: D1 Close
items.description: Day 1 planning complete. Overnight recess. Staff work overnight preparation for D2 orders production.

items.title: D2 Morning Brief
items.description: D2 commences. Staff present final COA refinements. Orders production begins.

items.title: Wargame
items.description: Structured wargame of the selected COA. Red team plays the enemy. Staff refine the plan based on wargame results.

items.title: Orders Production
items.description: Staff produce the full OPORD (Operation Order) covering all elements: ground, air, info ops, cyber, logistics.

items.title: Rehearsal of Concept
items.description: All element commanders rehearse the plan on the map/model. Confirm timings, coordination measures, decision points.

items.title: Pre-STARTEX Brief
items.description: Final brief before combat operations. Commander confirms H-Hour, conditions, communications, and emergency procedures.

items.title: D2 Close — Pre-Deployment Silence
items.description: D2 activities complete. Pre-deployment operational security hold begins. No further planning inputs.

items.title: D3 Combat Operations — H-Hour
items.description: H-Hour. Full spectrum operations commence. Information operations, cyber, and ground elements initiate simultaneously.

items.title: Information Operations Phase
items.description: PSYOPS and information operations executed. Target audiences: enemy command, civilian population, international media.

items.title: Cyber: Offensive Operations
items.description: Cyber element executes offensive cyber operations against designated enemy C2 networks (simulated).

items.title: SITREP D3 1200
items.description: Midday D3 report. H+4 status across all domains: ground, info, cyber, air.

items.title: Ground Phase Alpha — Advance
items.description: Ground forces advance on primary and secondary axes. Contact expected at Phase Line GREEN.

items.title: Air-Ground Integration
items.description: Air-ground integration. CAS missions supporting ground advance. FAC-qualified personnel forward with each element.

items.title: SITREP D3 1800
items.description: Evening D3 SITREP. Ground progress, air tasking results, info ops assessment.

items.title: Night Operations D3
items.description: Night combat operations. NVG-equipped elements continue advance. Fires suppression of enemy reverse slope positions.

items.title: SITREP D4 0200
items.description: Night SITREP. Overnight contact reports, casualty returns (simulated), ammunition state.

items.title: D4 Operations Continue
items.description: D4 daytime operations. Deep fires, suppression, and ground consolidation of D3 gains.

items.title: Cyber: Defensive Operations
items.description: Cyber element transitions to defensive operations. Protect friendly C2 networks from enemy counter-cyber.

items.title: SITREP D4 1200
items.description: D4 midday SITREP. Combined domain assessment.

items.title: Ground Phase Bravo — Exploitation
items.description: Phase Bravo begins. Armoured exploitation through enemy main defensive belt.

items.title: Decision: Transition to Stability
items.description: Commander makes the transition decision. Conditions: enemy conventional threat neutralised; population secure; governance gap identified.

items.title: SITREP D4 2200
items.description: Late D4 report. Combat operations status and transition readiness.

items.title: Final Night Operations
items.description: D4 final night. Security consolidation. Civil-military coordination teams deploy forward.

items.title: D5 Transition Brief
items.description: D5 morning. Transition to stability brief. Rules of engagement updated. Civil affairs teams take lead.

items.title: Stability Operations
items.description: Stability operations phase. Security, reconstruction, governance support, essential services restoration.

items.title: Reconstruction Planning Conference
items.description: Multi-agency conference: military, civilian agencies, NGOs. Plan for infrastructure restoration and security handover.

items.title: LOGREP Final
items.description: Final 5-day logistics report. Resource expenditure, replacement requirements, sustainment plan for stability phase.

items.title: Full Spectrum AAR
items.description: Comprehensive 5-day AAR. Domain-by-domain assessment: ground, air, info ops, cyber, stability. Commander's summary.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: 5-day full spectrum warfare exercise concluded. All exercise roles released. Synthetic time deactivated.
